title: `broadcast_in_dim` skips the transpose if the result shape equals the operand shape
description: and its docstring uses `broadcast_dimensions=(1, 0)` as an implicit transpose.
But if the result has the shape of the operand, as for a square matrix,
JAX silently returns the operand instead of permuting its axes.
This happens in eager mode, under `jit` and under differentiation.
**Cause.** `_broadcast_in_dim_fwd_rule` forwards the operand whenever `shape` equals the operand shape,
without checking that `broadcast_dimensions` is the identity.
The equation is then dropped from the jaxpr.
**Fix.** Forward the operand only if `broadcast_dimensions` is also `(0, 1, …, ndim - 1)`.
reproducer: # For a square operand, JAX returns the operand instead of its transpose.
# The equation is missing from the jaxpr.
